_why: Alternative to zed-settings-snippet.json for when the Rust extension cannot be built.
Zed compiles dev extensions to wasm32-wasip2, which requires Rust installed via rustup;
if that is not available, this file reaches the same language server by overriding the
binary of a server the Verilog extension already registers -- no Rust, nothing to build.
`svls` is used as the host slot because the Verilog extension launches it with no extra
arguments. Its name will appear in Zed's UI instead of `svannot`, which is cosmetic.
This is unverified: if Zed asks the extension for a binary before honouring binary.path,
it may try to download the real svls. If that happens, use the rustup route instead.
